items.html: (To the question) Because there is there a level of Phase Two from the phase of clothing, which is the phase of Israel Saba, and Yeshsut is the phase of HaVaYaH of SAG. (p. 485, entry "and behold")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 92:1
items.html: (To the question) Through the ascent of the bottom Hey to the Einayim, which was in Tzimtzum Bet [Restriction Two], meaning that Malchut rose to Hochma, Malchut mixed and joined with every Sefira up to Hochma. (p. 485, entry "Malchut")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 93:1
items.html: For the seven kings called by the name BON came out in a complete Partzuf, Rosh and Guf, and they broke, face and posterior. Therefore there are shells in them from head to foot, meaning in all of its RTS, and all the phases of the Rosh of the seven kings fell to Beria. And all the phases of the Toch of the seven kings fell to Yetzira. And all the phases of the Sof of the seven kings fell to Assiya. (p. 486, Item 2, and in Inner Light, Sub Header, “And there is”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 94:1
items.html: Because at the time of Katnut it lacks GAR, since this is so from the essence of its emanation; but at the time of Gadlut it attains GAR from the discernment of addition, and the shells have no suckling from there. For at the time that the lower ones commit a blemish, before the blemish is revealed, the GAR immediately depart from ZA. For anything that does not come with the Partzuf from the beginning of its emanation can depart from the Partzuf when the need arises. (p. 488, Item 5. And in the Inner Light, Sub Header, “ZA”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 95:1
items.html: (To the question) Malchut is always called by the name point, after the root Malchut, over which the first restriction was made. Therefore the aspect of the very subject of the restriction and screen, over which the coupling is made, is called everywhere by the name point. (p. 490, Item 8. And in the Inner Light, s.v. "points".)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 96:1
items.html: There are four states: Achor b'Achor [back to back], Achor b'Panim [back to face], Panim b'Achor [face to back], and Panim b'Panim [face to face]. This is at the time when the male and female lack the three upper [Sefirot], because of the rising of the bottom Hey into the eyes. The first correction that suffices to support them in Atzilut is Achor b'Achor, meaning that they attain the light of the backs of Ima Ila'ah, for since she desires the light of Hassadim, in the secret of "for He desires kindness," she is found to reject the light of Hochma. Therefore, when they are included in this light and in these backs, they are not blemished at all for lacking Hochma, because of the bottom Hey in the eyes, for even if they were able to receive Hochma, they would likewise reject its reception, because of the desire for Hassadim imprinted in the backs of Ima Ila'ah. Therefore the backs of Ima serve them as though they were the light of the three upper [Sefirot]. And this is the first correction, called Achor b'Achor.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 96:2
items.html: The second state is Achor b'Panim. For besides the diminishing and restriction of the light of Hochma because of the bottom Hey in the eyes, there is also a diminishing and restriction of the light of Hochma in the vessels of face of the female: for because of the sealing over the light of Hassadim that is in her vessels of face, she is not fit to receive the light of Hochma, since the light of Hochma is not received in the Partzuf without Hassadim. Therefore, after the diminishing because of the bottom Hey in the eyes is corrected by the coupling of Achor b'Achor, as above, the coupling of back to face is made, in which the male bestows upon her the light of Hassadim in abundance, and corrects the vessels of face of the female, thereby preparing her to be fit to receive the light of Hochma in them.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 96:3
items.html: The third state is Panim b'Achor. This is reached by the upper coupling of AB SAG, which brings the bottom Hey down from the eyes and restores the Hochma and Bina to the Rosh, so that the male then attains his light of face as at first, before the diminishing. But the female no longer turns her face to the face of the male to receive the light of Hochma, without a cause obligating her to do so. This is because of her backs, on the part of the Bina of Ohr Yashar [direct light], in the secret of "for He desires kindness." Therefore the female then receives the light of face from the male through her backs, so that by this the light of Hochma is diminished greatly, and this coupling is called Panim b'Achor [face to back], since the face of the male bestows upon the female through her backs, and the vessels of face receive from the vessels of backs.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 96:4
items.html: The fourth state is Panim b'Panim. This is reached only by the raising of MAN [female waters] from the aspect of ZON, for Bina has a connection with ZON on the part of the ten Sefirot of Ohr Yashar, in that Bina bestows upon them the light of Hochma. Therefore, when ZON rise to her as MAN, she cuts off her backs and turns her face to Hochma in order to receive from it the light of Hochma for the sake of ZON, and she is then found coupling with Hochma face to face. (page 498, items 23–25, and Inner Light there.)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 97:1
items.html: (To the question) By means of the upper coupling of AB and SAG, which brings the bottom Hey down from the eyes, and returns the HB to the Rosh, the male attains the aspect of his face, but the female still needs the raising of MAN. Therefore their coupling is made in the aspect of face to back. As above, in the adjacent utterance. (p. 500, s.v. "above")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 98:1
items.html: (To the question) The raising of MAN to Bina from the phase of ZON arouses Bina to turn her Panim back to Hochma. As above, Answer 96. (p. 501, entry "the degree")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 99:1
items.html: (To the question) In ZON, all four states apply: Achor be Achor [back to back], Achor be Panim [back to face], Panim be Achor [face to back], and Panim be Panim [face to face]. But in AVI, the aspect of Achor be Panim does not apply; only Achor be Achor, Panim be Achor, and Panim be Panim apply. (p. 502, Item 25. And in Inner Light, entry "in AVI.")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 100:1
items.html: When ZON are in the phase of back to back, they have only the wall of HGT, which is the phase of the posterior of Ima, as above in Answer 96. Both of them use this posterior together: half of it for ZA, and half of it for Nukva. But the posterior of NHY is lacking to both of them, being in the secret of “and their backs were toward the house.” For the posterior of NHY are from the phase of the Yesod of Aba, which is not revealed except through new Hassadim and Gevurot that come with the illumination of Hochma. Therefore, when Hesed and Gevura come from the face-to-face coupling of Aba and Ima, then the posterior of NHY are also completed for both of them, and ZA takes the Hassadim for himself, and gives the Gevurot to the Nukva. See above, Answer 45. (p. 507, Item 29, and in Inner Light, Sub Header, “Hassadim”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 101:1
items.html: Just as the lower man, through good deeds, raises MAN to ZON, so ZON select from the posterior of Aba and Ima that fell to their place, and raise MAN to Aba and Ima. Likewise Aba and Ima do this above them, until the end of all the degrees, until the first, uppermost Partzuf draws Mochin from the light of Ein Sof, blessed be He, and brings them down to the one below it, and so they pass to ZON. Thus every raising of MAN by the righteous causes the light to descend anew from Ein Sof, blessed be He, Himself, for there is no renewal of light in any of the worlds that is not drawn from Ein Sof, blessed be He. Remember this. (p. 505, in Inner Light, Sub Header, “Caused”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 102:1
items.html: They are mainly Hassadim and Gevurot, except that they contain an illumination of Hochma, namely according to the measure of stature that is then in AVI: if they are at the stature of Keter, then these Mochin are from the phase of the illumination of Hochma of the Partzuf of Keter. And if they are at the stature of Hochma, the Mochin are found from the phase of the illumination of Hochma of the Partzuf of Hochma, and so on. (p. 518, Sub Header, “And in this you shall understand”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 103:1
items.html: The first is that these new Hesed-Gevura [pairs], which contain the illumination of Hochma, are found to enlarge and complete the backs of ZON, as mentioned above in answer 100. And the second is that they attain the Mochin of the face, which are their GAR, whereupon they couple face-to-face. (p. 507, Item 29)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 104:1
items.html: Three Partzufim emerged in Nekudim, which are: AVI in four levels, whose bodies are: Daat, Hesed, Gevura, and the upper third of Tifferet, down to the Chazeh. The second Partzuf is Yeshsut in four levels, whose bodies are: the lower two thirds of Tifferet, Netzah-Hod, Yesod, and Malchut. The third is the coupling of the two crowns in Daat, which emerged as a Rosh without a Guf. (p. 513, Item 39. And in the Inner Light, Sub Header, “The Seven Kings.” And p. 545, Item 73. And in the Inner Light there.)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 105:1
items.html: There were many causes there, but the cause of their death and their descent to BYA was the mixture of phase four, which mixed into those vessels of the seven kings and is unfit to receive from the upper light. Therefore, when the light came to encounter phase four, it immediately departed and separated itself from the entire vessel, and the vessel died and fell into BYA, meaning below the line of Ein Sof that ends at the ground of Atzilut. There they fell into the shells, and after the admixture of phase four is selected and separated from them, they are returned to Atzilut, in the secret of the resurrection of the dead. This is done by the new MA, as will be explained in its place, with God's help. (p. 431, Item 42, and in Inner Light there, p. 430, Sub Header, “Included,” and in Inner Light, p. 486, Sub Header, “The Dross”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 106:1
items.html: (To the question) Only the lights that came out from the coupling of Gadlut of AVI were annulled, but what was in AVI from the beginning of their emanation, nothing at all was annulled. (p. 509, Item 31)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 107:1
items.html: Its Rosh, namely the discernment from below upward, is the Rishayhu of AVI, called the mutual looking of the eyes of AVI, which emerged upon phase four of clothing and phase three of coarseness, which were included one within the other, bringing out the level of Keter. And the body of this level of Keter, which is its discernment from above downward, expanded in the king Daat. And it is the discernment of Yechida of ZON. (p. 518, Item 41. And in the Inner Light there, Sub Header, “Daat”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 108:1
items.html: Its extension from below upward is called the Guf of Abba, which emerged through phase three of clothing and phase two of coarseness, whose level reaches Hochma. And the Guf of this level expanded into the reign of King Hesed. It is the aspect of Haya of ZA. (p. 520, Items 42, 43)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 109:1
items.html: (To the question) Its phase of from-below-upward is called Guf of Ima, which came out on the coarseness of phase two alone, whose level reaches to Bina, and the Guf expanded in the King of Gevura. And it is the phase of Neshama of ZA. (p. 521, Item 43)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 110:1
items.html: Its extension from below upward is called the Yesodot of AVI [Abba ve-Ima], which emerged through the coarseness of phase one, whose level reaches ZA. And from above downward, this level expanded into the reign of King Tifferet, down to his chest. It is the aspect of Ruach of ZA. (p. 522, Item 45)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 111:1
items.html: Its phase from below upward is called the Rishayhu of Yeshsut, and the mutual looking of the eyes of Yeshsut, which came out on a screen from the phase of the clothing of, and from the coarseness of, phase two, whose stature reaches Hochma. And its body extended into the king Tifferet, in its lower two thirds, from the Chazeh downward to its end. And it is the phase of Haya of the Neshama of ZA. (p. 522, Item 45)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 112:1
items.html: (To the question) Its phase of from-below-upward is called Guf of YESHSUT, which came out on a screen of phase two, and its Guf expanded in the King of Netzah and Hod. And it is the phase of Neshama of the Neshama of ZA. (p. 526, Item 46)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 113:1
items.html: (To the question) Its phase of from-below-upward is called Yesodot of YESHSUT, which came out on the coarseness of phase one, whose level reaches to ZA, and its Guf expanded in the King of Yesod. And it is the phase of Ruach of ZA of the Neshama. (p. 527, Item 47)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 114:1
items.html: Its extension from below upward is called the Malchuyot of YESHSUT [Yisrael-Sava and Tevuna], which emerged through the screen of the aspect of root, whose level reaches Malchut. And its extension from above downward expanded into the seventh king, which is Malchut. It is the aspect of Nefesh of Neshama of ZA. (p. 527, Item 47)
